ITEM 1 | Sliced piece of dark brown meat with a browned, slightly glossy outer edge and pale pinkish-tan interior, roughly 5 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, sitting at the left edge of the greens; about 1.5 cm thick, firm and dense-looking | 60
ITEM 2 | Second slice of dark brown meat, browned exterior, slightly glossy, about 4 cm long and 2 cm wide, partly overlapping the first slice and the greens, about 1.5 cm thick | 40
ITEM 3 | Whole drumstick-shaped piece with golden-brown crisp-looking skin, pale creamy interior exposed at the bone end, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide at the thickest part, with a bone protruding from the lower end, sitting at the upper right of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Mixed salad greens: a loose pile of dark green and purplish-red leaves, some crinkled and some flat, with pale green lettuce-like leaves, moist with a slight sheen, covering roughly a third of the plate in a loose mound about 1.5 cm tall | 45
ITEM 5 | Thin strips of bright red pepper, glossy and slightly wrinkled, about 4 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, scattered among the greens | 8
ITEM 6 | Thin pale green strips, possibly stem or vegetable pieces, crisp-looking, about 3 cm long, scattered among the greens near the center | 5
ITEM 7 | Round slice of yellow corn cob, bright yellow kernels in a compact ring with a pale center, about 5 cm in diameter and 2 cm thick, slightly moist, sitting at the right edge of the plate | 35
